title: Judgement Mode
description: Judgement system used for the timeline: v1 (osu!stable windows and LN judging) or lazer (osu!lazer windows, hold head/tail judging).

title: Step Milliseconds
description: Step size in milliseconds for the timeline (default: 1000ms)

title: Window Milliseconds
description: Window size in milliseconds for the timeline (default: 10000ms)

title: Gap Milliseconds
description: Gap size in milliseconds for the timeline (default: 6000ms)
